book.title: The Heroin Diaries: A Year In The Life Of A Shattered Rock Star
book.description: Set against the frenzied world of heavy metal superstardom, the co-founder of Motley Crue offers an unflinching and gripping look at his own descent into drug addiction. It follows him during the year he plunged to rock bottom and his courageous decision to pick himself up and start living again."
